message: リ・クリエ

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, alright, could you two wrap it up already?」

name: Azel
message: 「Y-You guys!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Treasurer, jealousy is unsightly. You have already been kicked by a donkey and died」

name: Misa
message: 「It's a horse」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The doors open in two minutes, you know!」

name: Ria
message: 「I really think you should save the rest for somewhere else, you know」

name: Azel
message: 「Th-There is no 'rest'! And before that, stop watching!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Listen, the fate of the world was on the line, and on top of that, you two were flirting right in the middle of the venue--we couldn't help but watch even if we didn't want to!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aah, seriously, you put on such a show it made me want to say, 'Yeah, yeah, thanks for the feast, knock it off already'」

name: Paqy
message: 「My condolences, man」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even so, that was my first time seeing a live kiss. It was very educational」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I-I was considerate and immediately looked away! Really, I did!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ahem. You really had me on edge. Sakura-kun just kept talking about pointless things」

name: Misa
message: 「Though I suppose it's fine since the world wasn't destroyed, thanks to Azel-san」

name: Azel
message: 「It wasn't pointless! Synn was the one who made me realize it!」

name: Synn
message: 「I wouldn't go that far... Still, were our voices really that loud?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Though I knew it was impolite, we picked up your entire exchange with a directional mic and broadcast it to everyone」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek」

name: Helena
message: 「Even so, you've got quite the nerve, deceiving an adult like that」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Please wait! Not attacking was something the entire Student Council decided on, and」

name: Lolotte
message: 「To begin with, friends fighting each other is pure nonsense! Anyone who suggests such a thing is a demon!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, Lolotte-chan, are you calling me a demon」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hau! I accidentally let my true feelings slip out!」

name: Helena
message: 「You know, I never actually told you to attack Azel.」

name: Misa
message: 「Whaaat?!」

name: Helena
message: 「I only told you to go save the world, didn't I?」
Now that she mentions it, that's true.

name: Helena
message: 「So, was it this mouth that called me a demon?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm in big trouble!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena, that's quite mean of you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot, what about the magic circle here?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I destroyed it while you were all dancing. About ten percent of its function remains, but now that the main body has settled down, it shouldn't be a problem.」

name: Azel
message: 「Melilot...」

name: Azel
message: 「Um... After causing you so much trouble... well... even now」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please come stay over again. Anytime is fine.」

name: Azel
message: 「Y-Y-Yeah. Of course!」
Helena straightened her back and turned toward us,

name: Helena
message: 「Members of the Crusaders! I thank you for making the impossible possible once again!」

name: Helena
message: 「All that remains is seeing the Holy Night Festival through to the end. I expect the final event, the dance party, to be a success! Dismissed!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Roger!」
Misa took out her phone and,

name: Misa
message: 「Shio. Let the guests start entering.」
A commotion breaks out at the entrance of the venue.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Get up already, you two! Do you really want to show off that badly?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, no, it's not like that」

name: Azel
message: 「Sorry. I can't stand up.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn. At times like this, a boy has to lend a helping hand.」
I stood up first and offered my hand to Azel.

name: Synn
message: 「Um」

name: Azel
message: 「Y-Yeah」
Even though we were holding each other just a moment ago, I feel weirdly bashful and can't meet his eyes.
With both of us still turning our faces away from each other, Azel stood up.

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel-san! Is the power of Re-Crea no longer inside you right now?」

name: Azel
message: 「Y-Yeah, that's right. My power got taken along with it」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Eeeh! C-C-C-Could you mean your spiritual essence!? Then, to Heaven, you can no longer--」

name: Azel
message: 「It just means it's dropped to a completely ordinary level」

name: Azel
message: 「Besides, something like that is trivial. The problem now is--」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun! What happened to Virus? You sent him back to the Demon World, didn't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「No. It seemed like he was satisfied after fighting me」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then, he's still in the Human World?」

name: Synn
message: 「He was collapsed the last time I saw him, though. Melphas might know」

name: Melphas
message: 「Did you call for me? Student Council President」
I leaped back about a meter!

name: Synn
message: 「D-Don't suddenly blow into my ear like that!」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-The pervert from back then!」

name: Melphas
message: 「When one has an appointment, arriving at the designated place before the other party is simply a matter of course for a gentleman」

name: Melilot
message: 「I don't care about your gentlemanly code. What did you do with Virus?」

name: Melphas
message: 「I left him lying on the bench in front of the church. Was that not to your liking?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even Virus is going to catch a cold like that!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Is that really the issue here?」

name: Helena
message: 「Tamiko-chan! Can you check in front of the church?」

name: Riesling
message: 「One moment, please」
Riesling-san contacted someone on her cell phone.

name: Riesling
message: 「Residual heat was confirmed on the bench, but there is no sign of anyone there」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun! Helena! Stop the admissions immediately!」

name: Helena
message: 「Hmm. No can do」
Students and residents of Ryuusei Town are already streaming in through the venue entrance.

name: Synn
message: 「What's going on, Melilot-san?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Can't you feel the tremors, faint though they may be?」

name: Ria
message: 「I thought they were just aftershocks from Re-Crea, though」

name: Sally
message: 「Phew, that was fun! Huh? Why does everyone look so serious?」

name: Melilot
message: 「If the power residing within Azel-san had vanished from this dimension, the tremors would have stopped completely」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So you mean it's still here?」

name: Misa
message: 「What did you say!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, beings capable of hosting Re―Crea are rare even in Heaven or the Demon World―」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be」
Pillars of light shot up toward the night sky from all across the academy.

name: Misa
message: 「What is happening!?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Luminous phenomena have been confirmed at eleven locations on campus」

name: Amyrina
message: 「T-The magic circles are activating! N-No way……」

name: Synn
message: 「Didn't we strip them of their functions!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「The remaining ten percent is reacting to the reactivation of Re-Crea」

name: Azel
message: 「It's coming…… I can tell…… The power that was inside me……」
A strange commotion could be heard coming from the direction of the venue entrance.

name: Eddie
message: 「Wh-Wh-There's some guy looking weirdly punk!」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「What what what!? Whoaaaa! Something crazy's happening!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「As an apostle of truth, I must snap, snap away!」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Hey, don't get close! I've got a bad feeling about that guy!」

name: Shio
message: 「Who goes there! State your name and surname at once, or I shall cut you down!」
Looking toward the direction of Shio-chan's clear, ringing voice,

name: Synn
message: 「Virus...?」

name: Misa
message: 「That guy...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Doesn't he... look kind of weird?」

name: Azel
message: 「He's here... But why... Didn't he understand...」
Virus's entire body was twitching slightly, and his eyes looked somewhat hollow.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh, I've seen that before~ Young kids who mess with dangerous drugs end up like that~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You sure do keep some mighty strange company, don't you now?」

name: Melilot
message: 「If it were merely drugs, that would still be rather quaint.」

name: Ria
message: 「Q-Quaint, really?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Stop talking about things that'll taint Ria-chan's ears!」

name: Shio
message: 「Did you not hear me declare that I would cut you down if you failed to state your business!?」
Ignoring Shio-chan, Virus starts heading toward us.

name: Shio
message: 「Then forgive me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't, Shio-chan!」
Before my words could even reach her, Shio-chan lunged in to slash, and

name: Shio
message: 「Wh-What!」
Without the tip of her blade even touching Virus, her petite body was sent flying back!

name: Misa
message: 「Shio!」
When I rushed over, Shio-chan looked surprisingly unfazed,

name: Shio
message: 「How careless of me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, that's really not the issue right now.」

name: Riesling
message: 「May I lift the restriction on weapon usage?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Not even a nuke could take that down.」
As the students and people of Ryuusei Town watched from a distance, Virus stepped out into the center of the plaza with unsteady steps and raised both hands toward the heavens.

name: Virus
message: 「Oooooooooooooooooh!」
A massive pillar of light rose up, flooding the surroundings with a cold white radiance.
The pillar was so gigantic it pierced straight through the night sky.

name: Melilot
message: 「Re-Crea...」

name: Azel
message: 「My Lord...」
An overwhelming presence.
The surging awe threatens to crush me.
My senses feel like they're twisting apart from the dense magical power overflowing from its core.

name: Synn
message: 「B-But! Isn't it in a less complete state than when it was dwelling inside Azel?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Indeed, the compatibility is likely not as high as it was with Azel-san.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, Re-Crea only needs a brief moment to complete its purpose. It will easily hold out for that long.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way...」
Is this because of my own softness?
Should I have fought until it was completely annihilated, just like when I fought Soltia?
Like that time when I lost myself in the fight and realized too late that I'd wiped Soltia out of existence.
Still, Virus was so graceful when he admitted defeat that finishing him off never even crossed my mind.
Was that a mistake? Is that kind of sentimentality going to destroy the world?
The ground begins to ripple once more.
A rainbow-colored meteor shower pours down as if to blanket the night sky, faintly lit by pillars of light.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-Isn't this super bad?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「E-Eeek! What are we supposed to do about this?! There's a limit to positive thinking!」

name: Misa
message: 「D-Don't tell me you're giving in to despair, Sakura-kun! Because I'm certainly not!」

name: Azel
message: 「So... no matter what, my Lord intends to destroy this world...」

name: Ria
message: 「I-It'll work out somehow! We've always managed to pull through before!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Doesn't look like it's gonna attack us.」

name: Synn
message: 「Now that you mention it...」
Re-Crea simply remains there in silence, making no move to strike.
The very thing meant to destroy the world is purely beautiful, looking as far removed from anything sinister as could be.

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, even without attacking, just existing is gonna return everything to primordial chaos.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Things being this bad is a first as far as my memory goes. Even the first Demon Lord wasn't in a pinch quite this tight.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even if the world ends after this, there's no shame in it」

name: Paqy
message: 「So come on. Let's struggle as pathetically as we can」
That's right.
Things can't possibly get worse than the world ending.
Then I'll just do what I can. Just like always.
I gave a small laugh.

name: Synn
message: 「Your memory isn't reliable anyway, Paqy」

name: Paqy
message: 「You got me there. Sure, maybe worse things have happened. Nah, I just forget the bad stuff」

name: Synn
message: 「If they did, we'll be fine. Because the world is still going」
We'll be fine.

name: Synn
message: 「Guiding my master, descending by ancient covenant--Avanshell, Angel of Pitch-Black Darkness!」
Spirit Power swirled around me, and I transformed.

name: Azel
message: 「Synn... It's impossible... I understand Re-Crea better than anyone. That's why」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「...Because I... already accepted Re-Crea...」

name: Synn
message: 「I told you just now, didn't I? That no matter how many times it takes, I'll save the world and tell you I love you, Azel. That I'll say it over and over」

name: Azel
message: 「But!」

name: Synn
message: 「If God were perfect and only wanted to destroy the world, He wouldn't give us a grace period like this」

name: Synn
message: 「It means we still have a chance」

name: Azel
message: 「Even so, what do you think you can do!」

name: Synn
message: 「For starters, I'll hear it out」

name: Azel
message: 「Synn!」
Pushing through the swirling vortex of Re-Crea's power, I tried to get closer to Virus--no, to Re-Crea.
However, the surging magical power was so dense it felt almost as viscous as water, hindering my steps.
Suddenly, I felt something soft and warm against my back.
A voice spoke right by my ear.

name: Azel
message: 「Synn. Use my power」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...」
Azel is hugging me from behind.

name: Paqy
message: 「Are you sure about this?」

name: Azel
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Synn
message: 「But... earlier, you said your power was gone.」

name: Azel
message: 「That just means I'm normal now. Don't worry.」
Along with his words, power comes flowing into me.
A mysterious power--warm, making my blood run hot.
As the inflowing power fades, that soft sensation pulls away, almost reluctantly.

name: Azel
message: 「I'm counting on you.」
Step by step, I push forward through the swirling power.
The closer I get to the center, the more my willpower is constricted, screaming in agony.
Just when I reach the point where I can't take another step, I hear a voice.

name: Virus
message: 「Is that... the Demon Lord... there?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, it is.」
Is it a voice? Or is Virus's will simply resonating within my Demon Lord senses?
Even so, I definitely heard it.

name: Virus
message: 「...Then... defeat me... Please, defeat me...」
It sounded like the voice of someone trapped inside ice.

name: Virus
message: 「It forced its way inside me... This is not my will...」

name: Synn
message: 「Can't you hold it back somehow?」

name: Virus
message: 「Impossible... This is the ultimate power... It's a miracle I'm even keeping my sanity like this...」
Indeed, the voice reaching me is frail, sounding as though it could fade away at any second.

name: Virus
message: 「Though even that... won't last much longer...」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you have any last words?!」

name: Virus
message: 「I... fought the strongest warrior and lost... I was satisfied...」

name: Virus
message: 「This... is not my battle...」

name: Synn
message: 「B-But, regardless of how it happened, isn't this the ultimate power?!」

name: Virus
message: 「The ultimate power I spent... my entire life chasing... turns out to be a rather crude thing...」

name: Virus
message: 「Surrounded by mountain peaks... holding its serenity... the surface of a lake... simply remaining there in stillness...」

name: Virus
message: 「Overwhelming... a world of absolute zero... nothingness... merely existing...」

name: Virus
message: 「Besides... a power you cannot control yourself is meaningless to begin with...」

name: Virus
message: 「Truly... truly boring...」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you think... I can defeat it?」
The fading connection of wills echoes faintly.

name: Virus
message: 「...It's... impossible. However, the Demon King is... fated to fight Re-Crea... You are the only possibility」

name: Synn
message: 「Does it have a weakness somewhere!?」

name: Virus
message: 「Ultimate... power... has no weakness... Yet if... there is one, it must lie in the very nature... of the Demon King's existence...」
Suddenly, his will cut off like a tripped breaker.
How are we supposed to fight a power that crushed even Virus, who possessed strength nearly equal to the Demon King's?

name: Synn
message: 「What does 'the nature of the Demon King's existence' mean?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It means your own way of living, Master Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「Mine?」

name: Paqy
message: 「There ain't no rulebook saying a Demon King has to act a certain way. Can be a guy or a girl, weak or strong.」

name: Paqy
message: 「A Demon King is naturally a Demon King, so long as they live without betraying their own will.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I don't really get it, so it just means me being me?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Beats me, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「You just ruined a great speech!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What got ruined?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you getting spooked for!」
Before we knew it, we had stepped out of the range of Re-Crea's dense power.

name: Ria
message: 「Synn. You mustn't go off on your own.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's right. Acting arbitrarily is a denial of democracy!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Honestly, you simply can't manage without me.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How on earth do you jump to that conclusion!?」
Everyone had already transformed.

name: Azel
message: 「Synn. My power is with you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahh! So lovey! Way too lovey! The way we're not even part of the equation... ugh, ugh, ugh!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's just sour grapes, pal.」
I turned to face everyone.

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone... are you really going to fight?」

name: Everyone
message: 「Sir, yes, sir!」

name: Synn
message: 「Our opponent is practically a god, you know? Ridiculously strong, okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「We are always together. From now on, forever.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why bring that up now? Ever since we were first told to save the world, we've been winging it and playing it by ear.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's true.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And this mission just happens to have a slightly higher difficulty level, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「We've definitely leveled up since then, so we'll be fine even if the difficulty is a little higher.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Besides, it's not just the President--you have me here too.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun is unreliable, so the world can't be saved without me.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, I am a familiar, after all. Gotta honor the code of the streets.」

name: Sally
message: 「With me around, I'm worth a hundred men! Prez!」

name: Shio
message: 「What are prodigies and gods to me!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Milady. This old butler shall accompany you to the ends of the earth.」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Ode, do best, repay, debt.」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone...」
Azel joined the party!
Their resolve seemed firm.
I might not be able to fight alone. But everyone is here. Everyone is here for me.

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, and you don't need to worry about the regular students.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa! Leave it to Helena-san! You evacuated everyone for us!」

name: Helena
message: 「Hmm. Not quite」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't think it's just 'not quite'...」

name: Helena
message: 「I told everyone it's an opening attraction for the dance party. Good luck」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat. What is that supposed to mean!?」
A familiar voice echoes through the venue.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh my, it's so big and shiny. How frightening. Could the world be coming to an end?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If the world ends, we won't be able to eat sweets anymore~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「However, there is no need to worry」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Because Lia and her companions, the Crusaders, will take good care of everything for us」

name: Ria
message: 「Why is Ayaka-chan going out of her way to emphasize my name」

name: Helena
message: 「I left the emceeing to those two」

name: Ria
message: 「Having everyone stare at me is a little embarrassing」

name: Helena
message: 「What are you talking about. If we'd left them alone, there would've been a panic」

name: Azel
message: 「Logical」

name: Misa
message: 「Azazel-san... hasn't she been a bad influence on you?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Everyone, let's cheer on the Sweets Club--oops, I mean the Crusaders~」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Hurry up and beat that thing already!」

name: Yumil
message: 「Yugiri-senpai! Save the world and get us promoted to an official club!」

name: Eddie
message: 「Woo-hoo, Ria-senpai's miniskirt is the best!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That little punk. He'd better watch his back at night」

name: Helena
message: 「See. It's a huge hit, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Please let them evacuate!」

name: Helena
message: 「If the world ends, there won't be anywhere to evacuate to anyway」
What kind of bizarre logic is that? No, wait, is she actually right?

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is fine, Mr. President. In a hero show attraction, the allies of justice always win!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aha, that's a good omen, huh! Means we're gonna win too!」

name: Azel
message: 「Logical」

name: Misa
message: 「I knew it, she's been corrupted...」

name: Helena
message: 「Besides, Melilot put up a simple barrier for us, so a little shockwave won't be a problem.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amyrina worked really hard helping out too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Please lead with that next time.」

name: Helena
message: 「And so, members of the Crusaders! Your mission is to save the world while throwing a dance party!」
Skip the battle?
